description: Find the claims in a text and check the ones plain code can: arithmetic, primes, unit conversions. Each claim is shown as PROVEN with holds true or false when a machine settled it, or GUESS, not checked, which never means false, with a next step. Its label field is the engine's word: PROVEN, FALSIFIED, OPEN (a famous unsolved problem such as P vs NP) or NOT CHECKED.

text.description: The sentence or answer to check, e.g. "2+2=5"

name: check_claim
title: Check a claim
